"''A box freighter? Mmm, it's not really flying, but yeah.|[[Gorn]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]|}} The '''Max-7 Rono box freighter''', also known as the '''Max-7 Rono''', the '''Rono freighter''', or simply a '''Rono''', was a class of [[box freighter]] used during the [[Imperial Era]]. ==Characteristics== [[FILE:Max7RonofreighterManual-Aldhani.png|thumb|left|250px|Max-7 Rono freighter diagram showing launch rail configuration]] The Max-7 Rono was a simple box [[freighter]] model that could be used to transport cargo over long distances. It featured an elevated [[cockpit]] that was accessible via a ladder in the front of the ship. The ship had a large open cargo space in the back, the sides of which opened outward and could be used as loading ramps. In the rear of the ship were its six [[engine]]s—three on each side—which included both sublight and [[hyperdrive]] units. It lacked [[acceleration compensator]]s so cargo had to be secure to prevent damage from loose objects. A custom-made Max-7 Rono could be launched from a ramp that had a track and overhead rail. The weight had to be calibrated before launch so the adjusted thrust ratio could be calculated and allow takeoff. The weight could be determined via a load clutch handle that was next to the booster throttle, which would display the weight on a gauge. ==History== [[File:Max7Rono-Andor105.png|thumb|right|250px|The Imperial Max-7 Rono docked on a rail mounting in the cargo bay of the Aldhani dam]] One Max-7 Rono was located at the [[Aldhani dam|Imperial base]] on [[Aldhani]] in a [[Alkenzi Air Base|hangar bay]] behind the dam's payroll vault. [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] learned that he would be [[pilot]]ing it during a rebel [[Aldhani heist|mission on Aldhani]] as it would be their escape craft. During the heist, the infiltrator team indeed reached the hangar as planned but they were attacked by base personnel under [[Corporal]] [[Kimzi]] mid-loading and suffered a casualty which forced them to retreat inside the freighter. Cassian then proceeded to launch the Rono through the tunnel and fly it directly into the [[Eye of Aldhani]] as instructed by [[Karis Nemik]], successfully evading three pursuing [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] and escaping to hyperspace. The rebel team used the freighter to reach their [[Quadpaw|doctor]] on the [[moon]] [[Frezno]], where they split ways with the team leader Vel getting to keep the Rono. {{Ship-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{1st}} {{C|Appears on screen}} *{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} *{{Andor|The Eye}} *{{Andor|Announcement}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|j5UX1Adanis|Andor | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/andor-teaser-trailer}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} *{{SWYouTube|Y4HjzJgG0e0|Timeline | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/timeline-andor}} *[[Andor: A Disney+ Day Special Look|''Andor'': A Disney+ Day Special Look]] *{{SWYouTube|PboKpnin_Wg|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (1:30)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer-disney}} *{{SWYouTube|SrFGN5x4M6A|Special Look | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/special-look-andor-disney}} *{{SWYouTube|GQ-fhJ4aBhE|Inside Look of Episodes 4-6 | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/inside-look-of-episodes-4-6-andor}} *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-episode-6-the-eye|text="The Eye" Episode Guide | Andor}} *{{ThisWeek|B2CRRJ_Wql4|Andor and the Eye, Galactic Pals Returns, and More!|sw_url=video/andor-and-the-eye-galactic-pals-returns-and-more}} *{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} *{{InsiderCite|222|A Certain Point of View}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|rono-freighter|Rono freighter}} {{1stID|Max-7 Rono box freighter}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Carguero Max-7 Rono |ja=マックス7ロノ箱型貨物船 |ka=კონტეინერული საფრახტო გემი მაქს-7 |nl=Max-7 Rono Freighter }} [[Category:Freighter classes]] [[Category:Starship classes of the Galactic Empire]]
